title: Intel AX210 Wi-Fi after sleep
line: Stops the Intel AX210 Wi-Fi card from crashing after sleep.
symptom: The AX210 enters D3cold during sleep, iwlwifi can't wake it, Wi-Fi is dead (sometimes even after a restart).
why: The Intel AX210 card (PCI 8086:2725), whichever handheld it is in; the fix checks for the card, so it is offered everywhere.
risk_note: One udev rule, the same one Bazzite ships.

changes.detail: Stops the Intel AX210 (8086:2725) from entering D3cold.
Set to 0 at once; the old value is saved.

undo: Deletes the rule and writes the saved value back.
bazzite: Fixed up to stable 45.20261105 (50-intel-ax200-ax210-disable-d3cold-state.rules, after issue 5867). Bazzite reverted that rule on 2026-11-08 (in testing and unstable 45.20261110), so later builds need ours again; the fix checks the system's own rules.
steamos: Not shipped as far as we can tell; the fix checks the system's own rules.

probe.what: Looks for the same rule from the system itself (any udev rule that isn't GameCove's and does the same), or the value already being right without GameCove.

watch.note: Bazzite's own rule (added after issue 5867, reverted on 2026-11-08 in commit a4807c3).
iwlwifi PCIe resume handling: a kernel fix would retire the rule everywhere.
